short_description: Berlin-headquartered German venture-capital fund-of-funds manager, founded in 2021 by serial entrepreneur Stephan Heller with co-founding partners Oliver Oster, Marius Weber and Marcus Boerner, that positions itself as a founder-driven VC-for-VCs vehicle. AlphaQ commits primary capital to a diversified portfolio of early-stage venture-capital funds mainly in Europe (with selective exposure to Israel and the United States), targets a total assets ambition of EUR 1 billion (initial target volume EUR 500 million) and has publicly reported allocations to funds including Northzone, Partech, Speedinvest, Headline, Nucleus Capital and White Star Capital, among others.
